$comment: One object per case; `skills` names what should load, `expected_behavior` lists what a passing run must do.

routing.query: I'm writing SKILL.md frontmatter and I'm not sure how long the description can be
expected_behavior: cites the 1024-char hard cap and the 300-char advisory target, sourced across agentskills.io, VS Code Copilot and the Codex parser
does not invent a platform-specific limit beyond the three loaders this repo certifies against

routing.query: Why does my skill never trigger even though it's installed?
expected_behavior: treats description as the routing mechanism and checks trigger phrases before anything else
points at name/directory mismatch as a common cause
